Aerial campus footage showing the University of Washington campus and surrounding paths.

For Washington For the world

Founded in 1861, the University of Washington is one of the world’s leading public research universities. The UW is where passion meets possibility. We inspire our students to make a difference — and prepare them to take action.

Explore how the Strategic Plan will shape the UW’s future

Get to know the University of Washington’s strategic plan — a roadmap for our future. Developed with input from faculty, students, staff, alumni and community partners, the plan will guide the UW through 2030 and beyond. Grounded in the University’s values and strengths, it’ll help us meet new challenges, serve our communities and take advantage of new opportunities.

Explore the plan

UW Campuses

Explore the University of Washington‘s three campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma.

UW Medicine

Providing lifesaving patient care, medical education and world-changing research.

Husky Athletics

Feel the Big Ten excitement and cheer on the Dawgs!

Arts and Culture

Discover libraries, museums, public performances and more.

Your ideas belong at the UW

Whether you’re applying, researching or partnering, there’s a place for your ideas here. Join the people turning shared curiosity into real-world solutions.

  • Start your UW journey: Apply by Nov. 15
  • Explore cross-disciplinary research
  • Learn about UW startups and innovators
  • Partner with the UW

Stories from across the UW

From student journeys to global impact — stories about the people and programs that make the UW a force for good.

View all stories

Featured story: ‘A beautiful challenge’

At a rural health clinic in northeast Washington, veteran and family nurse practitioner Devon Woodley, ’22, ’25, answers a lifelong call to serve.

  • Jordan Houghton, '15, receives UW Distinguished Alumni Veteran Award

  • UW researchers sow solutions with hydrogels

  • DNA Typewriter records cells’ history in early mouse embryo

Featured event

Nov. 10-21

Featured event: Veterans Appreciation Events

Join the UW as we host our annual Veterans Appreciation programs throughout the month.

  • Nov. 9

    Seattle Modern Orchestra, "90/100"

    UW residency celebrates the legacies of longtime former School of Music professors.

  • Nov. 11

    Veterans Day Ceremony

    Our annual Veterans Day Ceremony will take place at the Medal of Honor Memorial.

  • Nov 12

    Accelerating Research Day

    Explore the transformative power of AI and the impact it can have on organizations.

  • Nov. 13

    Research Computing Symposium

    Explore emerging tech and connect around the future of research computing

Application deadline is Nov. 15
